[[File:Keshtah.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The Earthcote River in eastern Keshtah Minor]]
The '''Eathcote River''' was a river on the eastern part of [[Keshtah Minor]], a continent on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] planet [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. It had been explored and cataloged by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] by [[4975 BBY]].

.
